repository.name: @webex/media-helpers
repository.purpose: Wraps internal-media-core local media streams with Webex server-mute authority and unmute gating, and re-exports the media and effects surface as one published SDK entry point.

public_interfaces.name: media-helpers-package-export
public_interfaces.audience: npm consumers and the Webex first-party clients, including the meetings plugin and the calling package
public_interfaces.notes: src/index.ts is authoritative for the exact export list; build:src emits the declarations that consumers type-check against.

public_interfaces.name: media-helpers-npm-scripts
public_interfaces.notes: test:broken and test:browser reference an integration suite this package does not define; neither is a working gate.

validate_with: spec-drift-changed over the changed source files and their owning module spec

generated_artifacts.refresh_with: Re-run Repo Annotation template setup against the bundled Repo Standards snapshot

minimum: human review against the cited source paths
recommended: spec-drift-changed for the affected module spec

affects: the internal server-mute contract consumed by the meetings plugin
change_impact.notes: The internal mute methods are stripped from published declarations, so a signature change breaks the meetings plugin without any published type break.

affects: the exact pinned upstream media and effects versions, which define most of the public surface
change_impact.notes: Both media dependencies are exact pins, so moving one is a deliberate public-surface change.

glossary.definition: A mute state imposed by the Webex server rather than by the local user.
glossary.notes: Distinct from a local mute, which the user initiates.

glossary.definition: Whether the server currently permits the local user to unmute; when false, unmuting throws.
glossary.notes: Held per stream instance and never persisted.

evidence_rules.requirement: A command must exist as a script in package.json before it is documented; test:broken and test:browser are known non-working and must not be cited as gates.
evidence_rules.notes: The full build-with-tests role is recorded as unresolved in the SDD manifest.

evidence_rules.requirement: Only symbols exported from the barrel may be documented as part of the published surface.
evidence_rules.notes: Members marked internal are stripped from published declarations.

evidence_rules.requirement: A behavior claim must cite the implementing source and, where it exists, the pinning test; uncovered behavior is recorded as a gap.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit and pull-request history are not accepted as evidence for this package.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer that this package implements media effects.
negative_guidance.why: The barrel re-exports them from the upstream effects package; the package README's claim that they are included here is recorded as stale.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat test:broken or test:browser as runnable verification.
negative_guidance.why: test:broken chains a test:integration script this package never defines, and no integration test directory exists.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change one stream subclass without the other.
negative_guidance.why: The microphone and camera classes hold deliberately duplicated logic; editing one diverges audio and video mute behavior.

high.expectation: The claim is backed by a cited source file and, for behavior, a passing test.

medium.expectation: Source evidence exists but no test pins it; document the behavior and record the coverage gap.

low.expectation: Neither source nor test supports the claim; stop and report the gap rather than inferring it.

main_entrypoints.name: package-barrel
main_entrypoints.purpose: The single published entry point for the package.
main_entrypoints.notes: package.json points main at the built dist/index.js and devMain at this file.

source_surfaces.name: stream-adapters
source_surfaces.notes: Holds all behavior this package adds over its upstream dependencies.

source_surfaces.name: value-presets
source_surfaces.notes: Facing mode, display surface, and camera resolution presets.

generated_surfaces.name: build-output
generated_surfaces.notes: Git-ignored; produced per build and published to npm.

generated_surfaces.name: repo-standards-templates
generated_surfaces.refresh_with: Re-run Repo Annotation template setup against the bundled Repo Standards snapshot
generated_surfaces.notes: .sdd/templates is a symlink to the monorepo-root template set, so this package holds no template copies of its own.

validation_entrypoints.name: unit
validation_entrypoints.scope: The whole package; 31 tests covering the mute state machine and the stream factories.
validation_entrypoints.notes: The only runnable verification gate this package has.

validation_entrypoints.name: lint
validation_entrypoints.notes: Runs ESLint with automatic fixing, so it rewrites the working tree.

workspace_packages.name: @webex/media-helpers
workspace_packages.notes: A single workspace member of the webex-js-sdk monorepo; install and build run from the monorepo root.

sync_paths.mechanism: Repo Annotation template setup, resolved from the bundled checksum-verified snapshot
sync_paths.notes: Reached through the .sdd/templates symlink to the monorepo root; never seeded per package.

surface_owners.edit_boundary: Behavioral changes must update docs/README.md and the unit suite in the same change.
docs/README.md is a protected canonical spec; changes go through spec reconciliation rather than in-place overwrite.
Owner-authored npm landing page; not generated and never rewritten by documentation tooling.

fallback_rules: When a command role has no committed command, record it as needing human input rather than inventing one.
When source and the package README disagree, follow the source and record the README statement as stale.
When a behavior has no test, document it and record the coverage gap instead of asserting it is verified.
